svg.title: 4.7 hours of a soak run: 155 kills, 99 database faults, 8 bursts, 0 violations
svg.desc: A timeline. Each red tick is the service killed with kill -9, as a power cut. Amber bars are the database cut, frozen or black-holed. Blue bands are bursts of one and a half times the load. Below, in teal, how many events behind the endpoints that must keep up were: it rises in each fault and always returns to nearly zero.
